prompt_notes.description_zh: 小软团投出、落地噗叽并散开；只有动作音效，无音乐、人声或环境底声。
prompt_notes.throw: A single short fast whoosh of a small object thrown through the air. A quick soft swish, rising then falling, stops cleanly. Isolated dry Foley.
prompt_notes.impact: A single lump of wet sticky mud hits a hard floor with a short low squelchy splat. A few small granular pieces patter and quickly stop. Isolated dry Foley.
prompt_notes.negative: music, melody, musical instruments, speech, voice, singing, environmental ambience, continuous background noise, wind blowing, birds, traffic, long reverb, echo
